item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a single 2024 manifesto or party platform that cleanly unified all of these strands into one doctrine. Instead, the governing direction is assembled from repeated statements and actions: economic stabilization, transitional justice, peace/de-escalation, and coercive sovereignty control.
